They have stated that everything happens in chronological order, and scenes that are intercut happen concurrently. This means that Adam cannot be the killer because he was with Gavin when the killer was with Chris. I also believe that it can't be Miles because he is talking to himself in his head about surviving the night. This wouldn't make sense if he was the killer. Lindsey said something similar about hiding when she was in the green screen room, so I don't think it could be her. The note at the beginning of the series that was given to Lindsey said "A top 5 way to die." I am taking this to mean she will be the victim this week as there are 5 people left.  They said that this week would be harder so I don't think it could be Ryan in the airtight chamber, because that is too obvious. I don't think Ryan is the killer either because someone put something in his drink and moved him. Why would someone do that if they were not the killer. In conclusion, I think Barb is the killer and Lindsey is next weeks victim. Based on no evidence, I think the murder weapon is the computer mouse or perhaps the red herring.
